name: Charades Bowl
description: Everyone secretly writes 3 phrases. Two teams. Round 1: describe. Round 2: act it out. Round 3: one word only. Same pool, three rounds — most points wins.

intro.message:
CHARADES BOWL!

You'll each write 3 phrases for the bowl. Then we split into teams and play three rounds with the same phrases:

Round 1: Describe (use any words except the phrase itself)
Round 2: Act it out (no talking)
Round 3: One word only (just one!)

phrases-1.prompt: Type a short, fun phrase for the bowl. Anything goes — movies, foods, animals, idioms. Keep it school-appropriate.

phrases-2.prompt: Phrase #2 — try something different from your first one.

phrases-3.prompt: Phrase #3 — last one, make it a good one!

round1-intro.message:
ROUND 1: DESCRIBE!

The describer can use any words EXCEPT the phrase itself. 60 seconds per turn. Get as many right as you can — then it's the other team's turn.

round1.instruction: Describe the phrase — say anything EXCEPT the words on the card.

round2-intro.message:
ROUND 2: ACT IT OUT!

Same phrases, same teams — but now no words at all. Just gestures. 60 seconds.

round2.instruction: Act it out — no words, no sounds!

round3-intro.message:
ROUND 3: ONE WORD!

Last round! You can only say ONE word per phrase. Choose wisely. 60 seconds.

end.message: Great game! Thanks for playing Charades Bowl.

recommendedFor: Best for groups that know each other a bit and aren't shy about performing. Great end-of-week energy.
